title: Financial Analyst

why_us: Woodbridge's analyst role starts from a client's order backlog and sales pipeline and turns it into a forecast, then adjusts the client's financials to standard deal practice for sell-side M&A. That is close to what I do at AMG Family Dental, where I build monthly forecasts and run budget-vs-actual variance analysis. At Northrop Grumman I audited 100+ financial models, so checking whether a model's assumptions hold up is familiar work. I want to apply those skills on live company sales, and the auction-based process looks like a fast way to learn.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Financial Analyst role at Woodbridge International. The work you describe, building forecasts from a client's backlog and pipeline and normalizing financials for a sale process, sits close to what I already do, and I would like to do it on M&A deals.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA, I direct financial operations for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. I build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, run budget-vs-actual variance analysis and send KPI reports to ownership. By improving financial reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix, I identified and recovered over $500K in annual revenue. I also automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation with Python, which cut processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flagged underpaid claims for follow-up.

As a Financial Analyst Intern at Northrop Grumman, I audited 100+ financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and I analyzed supplier costs and budget variances across programs and presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership. That taught me to question a model's assumptions before anyone relies on it, which matters when a buyer will test every number in a client's financials.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis University and a B.S. in Business Administration with a Finance major from Suffolk University. I work comfortably in advanced Excel, SQL and Python, and I can explain a number clearly to people who do not live in spreadsheets, as I do with practice ownership every month.

I am a US citizen, available immediately, and I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can support your analyst team.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
